title.ja: 神にも悪魔にもなれる男
title.en: The Man Who Could Become a God or a Demon!
title.x-jat: Kami ni mo Akuma ni mo Nareru Otoko

1.overview: Rin is enjoying a rather normal life living with his childhood friend Kaede due to family deaths on both sides. One day at school, two new classmates transfer into his class: Lisianthus, heiress to the Realm of the Gods, and Nerine, heiress to the Realm of the Demons. Rin is told that he has been picked to marry either one, though it will be his choice as to whom.
1.summary:
Rin’s having a normal day when he learns he’s been chosen to marry one of the two new girls in class: Sia, Princess of the Gods. and Nerine, Princess of the Demons.
Source: crunchyroll

2.overview: After a few days of adjusting to his new neighbors, Rin is starting to find it hard to cope with the recent changes in his life. Eventually, he starts to walk to and from school alone and one day while walking from school he meets a girl named Primula from the Realm of the Demons who is very attached to him, literally. When she comes home with him later, it is decided that she will live in Kaede's house from now on.
2.summary:
Rin is bummed to find out that Sia and Nerine’s pushy fathers are his new neighbors!
Source: crunchyroll

3.overview: Summer is almost here, but first the students must go through their final exams. While everyone is studying, Sia gets some help from Rin, even though it's not much.
3.summary:
As if adapting to life in this realm of existence wasn’t hard enough, now Sia’s faced with final exams! And if Rin doesn’t help her pass her tests, it could mean the end of the world. Literally!
Source: crunchyroll

4.overview: During the time when Rin and his classmates are cleaning their classroom, Nerine gets angry at a couple of guys bad-mouthing Rin and manages to nearly blow up the gym. Later, when a picnic is planned where everyone makes their own food to eat, Nerine must get help from Asa in order to learn how to cook.
4.summary:
The group’s planned a picnic to celebrate the end of exams, but Nerine can’t cook. How far will the poor little thing go to keep the others from finding out about her secret?
Source: crunchyroll

5.overview: With the ever-increasing presence of Nerine and Sia in Rin's life, Kaede is beginning to feel left out. When Kaede comes down with a cold, she tries to push herself so as not to be so much of a bother to Rin.
5.summary:
Poor Kaede can’t keep up with the competition, so she’s doing everything in her power to take care of Rin around the house. But as soon as her workload takes its toll, Rin must come to the rescue.
Source: crunchyroll

6.overview: With Rin and Kaede going to school so often, Primula is starting to miss Rin so one day she comes to school unanncounced, though eventually leaves with some coaxing by Rin. Later, it is decided that Primula needs some undergarments she is lacking and thus Rin and the rest of the girls go out to help Primula with this problem. During their outing, Rin buys Primula a new cat doll.
6.summary:
Primula can only watch as Rin and his friends head off for school, her age and her awkwardness leaving her stuck at home. While the girls plan a trip to the lingerie shop, Rin may have a more fitting solution.
Source: crunchyroll

7.overview: After a popular boy confesses to Asa, she's finding it hard to accept his feelings. After Asa gets injured during PE, Rin walks her home and they're able to grow closer together.
7.summary:
Rin might seem like the only guy in school, but there are others out there on the prowl - and one of them has eyes for Asa!
Source: crunchyroll

8.overview: Inspired by a horoscope she read, Sia decides to take the inititve and asks Rin out on a date. However, following the date as she planned it out earlier proves difficult as people they know keep on showing up.
8.summary:
Sia’s horoscope foretells true love if she can be more assertive, think more positively, and most importantly, wear the right pair of lucky panties!
Source: crunchyroll

9.overview: Now that summer's here, Rin and the girls have decided to go to the beach to have some fun. Everything goes smooth for a while, but when Rin and Sia are stranded offshore, what will they do?
9.summary:
Rin finds the girls eager to capture his attention at the beach: Nerine wants a hands-on swimming lesson, Asa goes top-off in the waves, but Sia trumps them both when she and Rin get a little private time.
Source: crunchyroll

10.overview: After what happened at the beach, rumors start flying around that Rin and Sia are to be wed. As emotions start flaring up, will the rumors turn out to be true?
10.summary:
Rumors are flying about Sia and Rin’s impending nuptials, and Nerine isn’t going to take it all lying down: she sneaks the hapless would-be Romeo away for some quality time of her own.
Source: crunchyroll

11.overview: During the summer break, Mayumi goes to eat at the restaurant Kareha works at, though forgets her wallet, so she must work off her debt for the day. During this time, Rin's teacher is finding it difficult to find a good man to be with.
11.summary:
Mayumi’s waiting tables to pay off an ice cream debt. No sweat, right? Actually, it’s more like no panties! It’s getting drafty as Mayumi navigates the busy dining room while trying to salvage her modesty!
Source: crunchyroll

12.overview: With the summer almost at an end, everyone is still trying to finish their summer homework before the deadline. Later on, Primula falls ill and Rin learns of her terrible past.
12.summary:
The gang is so focused on completing their summer homework that no one notices when Primula starts having health problems. If they don’t act soon, she might not make it through!
Source: crunchyroll

13.overview: With Primula taken back to the Realm of the Demons, Rin and Kaede try to cope with their missing family member. Ultimately, Primula's condition comes out in the open and the one and only cure is revealed.
13.summary:
Rin is beating himself up for sending Primula to heal in the Realm of the Demons after the gang receives disheartening news of her condition.
Source: crunchyroll

14.overview: After Nerine ran to the nearby park, she tells Rin about the past she had with her clone Lycoris and how it all ties in with Primula. Later, after Asa collapsed at Kaede's house, Rin goes to see her at her own home where Asa tells him some of her own past.
14.summary:
The heavy truth about Primula’s sad life is unveiled, and Nerine shares a story with Rin that only makes the whole ordeal even sadder. Everything is confusing enough even before Asa suddenly takes ill!
Source: crunchyroll

15.overview: Rin, Kaede, Nerine and Sia have gone to the Demon Realm in order to see Primula again and try to help her in any way. Ultimately, things take a turn for the worse when she starts to lose control of the magic stored in her body. What can Rin do to save her?
15.summary:
Rin and the girls travel to the Realm of the Demons to help Primula to heal. But stern warnings are issued and the dire consequences of the proposed last ditch effort loom darkly over the proceedings.
Source: crunchyroll

16.overview: While Rin is starting to spend more time with Asa, Sia is starting to feel that she's being left out. With no where else to turn, her other more assertive self surfaces and asks Rin out on a date.
16.summary:
With Asa back to her spunky self and Primula feeling better, Rin has a little spring in his step. He and Asa seem to be growing quite close. The ladies that love Rin take it in stride - except for one!
Source: crunchyroll

17.overview: After Sia's other self surfaces, Rin and she go out on a date completely led by Sia herself, with Rin more or less as her captive. How will Rin get out of this awkward situation? Meanwhile, the girls at school start to worry about where he's gone missing.
17.summary:
Sia has practically kidnapped Rin, causing him to miss out on some quality time promised to Asa. Rin would be advised to play along, because Sia isn’t being herself - she’s being two of her selves!
Source: crunchyroll

18.overview: Rin goes out on a date at an amusement park targeted towards couples which is planned by Itsuki, Mayumi, Nerine and Sia so that Rin would voice how he feels towards Asa.
18.summary:
Rin seems to be leaning towards one of the ladies. Sia and Nerine have seen the writing on the wall, and they’re putting some serious pressure on the guy - a confession is coming.
Source: crunchyroll

19.overview: Rin starts spending most of his time with Asa and completely ignores Kaede. Kaede's past is shown and her yandere personality is revealed.
19.summary:
Asa’a health problems seem to be getting worse, and Kaede’s become increasingly erratic with her jealous behavior. Two of the girls finally meet in physical confrontation. The results are shocking!
Source: crunchyroll

20.overview: After Asa suffers another attack, Kaede starts to realize all that she's done in the past few days, but still cannot come to terms with where Rin's feelings truly lie. With almost nothing left, what will she do when told Rin may be leaving her house for good?
20.summary:
With Asa suffering from a strange illness, Rin is staying at her bedside in hopes of nursing her back to health. Kaede simply can’t handle it, and people are starting to get hurt. It’s time for Rin to take a stand.
Source: crunchyroll

21.overview: Kaede has completely shut herself off from everyone, trying to think on what to do next. Before long, Primula finds that Kaede is gone and Primula runs to Rin to inform him. During her outing, she meets Asa and they have a talk about their feelings for Rin.
21.summary:
Kaede’s house will soon have a vacancy after Rin decides that he’s been treating the redhead all wrong. He’s also decided to finally confess to his true love.
Source: crunchyroll

22.overview: Rin has packed up all his things and has already found a cheap apartment to move into. On the day of the move, several of his friends come over and help him out.
22.summary:
Rin’s determined to move on from this tumultuous period of his crazy life and rents an apartment. But peace and quiet has to wait - Asa is very sick, and Rin has every reason to be worried!
Source: crunchyroll

23.overview: After Asa collapses once more, she's rushed to the hospital, though the doctors cannot do much to improve her condition. Asa's mother Ama reveals to Rin a deep dark secret about her past.
23.summary:
Asa holds the cure to her illness but she’s too stubborn to do the right thing even as Rin begs her to help herself. In the middle of the night, the crisis escalates toward a very sad ending.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: そして...... 大切なこと

24.overview: Asa escapes from the hospital and goes to the spot where Rin first confessed to her. Before long, Rin goes there to meet her, though there's still not much he can do. When all else has failed, Rin is prepared to do anything to save Asa.
24.summary:
Rin combs the streets after Asa escapes the hospital, but what can a guy do when the girl he cares for won’t listen to reason? He finds a drastic answer to the hardest question he will ever have to consider.
Source: crunchyroll

S1.overview: This episode introduces the audience to the entire cast of characters and a little of the back story for the main characters. It's a basic overview of the Shuffle! story and universe.
